steps.content: The duck's firepower is unbelievably strong! Your attack seems unable to crack its defense no matter how hard you try. It's almost as if it's using some kind of cheat code.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: It's locked its HP?! That's cheating! Are you serious?!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Damn it... It hit me twice! Even Hella wouldn't dare to do this to me...

steps.speaker: Berserk Duck
steps.content: Quack, quack quack quack... (Hesitation is defeat...)
